title: Make one final diff-scoped cold mutation campaign authoritative and calibrate review cost

outcomes.statement: Ledger work closes with one cache-cleared, diff-scoped mutation campaign after adversarial review fixes, records that campaign's wall-clock cost, and starts from review estimates calibrated to measured project history.
outcomes.demo: Initialize and calibrate a disposable readiness artifact, verify review equals ceil(implementation * 65 / 28), validate an existing artifact without mutation_minutes and a new artifact with it, and inspect the implementation plan to confirm the final cold campaign follows all review-fix tasks with no later implementation commit.

uncertainties.statement: How the measured 65/28 review-to-implementation ratio can become a mechanical default when readiness:init emits zero placeholders and accepts no estimate inputs.
uncertainties.resolution: Add an explicit readiness:calibrate command. It reads an existing artifact, replaces review with ceil(implementation * 65 / 28), recomputes total, and writes atomically. Invocation is optional and later manual edits remain valid; the validator adds no ratio rule or new error code. Francisco approved this design choice in the CHG-047 design dialogue.

uncertainties.statement: Whether adding mutation_minutes can preserve every historical readiness artifact without weakening the closed-object contract.
uncertainties.resolution: Declare mutation_minutes as an optional actuals property in both JSON Schema and model validation. When present it is a non-negative integer; absence remains valid, so historical artifacts require no rewrite and terminal completeness gains no new mandatory field.

uncertainties.statement: Where the requested implementation-plan ordering belongs when the repository has plan instances under docs/superpowers/plans but no global plan-template file.
uncertainties.resolution: Define the reusable ordering contract in WORK_READINESS.md and make the CHG-047 implementation plan itself conform: adversarial review and fixes first, then cache clear and one diff-scoped cold campaign as the final executable task, followed only by evidence and closure. No new plan parser or rejection path is introduced.
